name: Words
q: One word can repay a debt
Birds hear day words, mice hear night words
Words without feet travel a thousand miles
Kind words out, kind words back
The wise are slow to speak, quick to act
Grasp the matter; words will follow
A sparing tongue is the best treasure
Those who know do not speak
Two ears, one mouth: listen more
I have made this longer only because I have not had time to make it shorter
Whereof one cannot speak, thereof one must be silent
Spoken words fly away; written words remain
Without knowing the force of words, it is impossible to know people
